title: Lakshya Sen Reaches Kumamoto Masters Japan Semifinals
indian_angle: India's top male shuttler Lakshya Sen has advanced to the semifinals of a significant international tournament.
summary: Eighth seed Lakshya Sen, who recently won the Hylo Open, continues his strong form by reaching the semifinals of the Kumamoto Masters Japan, boosting his BWF World Tour ranking.

title: BAI Elections Scheduled for December 26 in Guwahati
indian_angle: The Badminton Association of India has announced the date and venue for its forthcoming elections, shaping the future leadership of Indian badminton.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) will hold its elections on December 26, 2026, in Guwahati, as per a recent circular.

title: 88th Senior National Badminton Championships Set for Bhubaneswar
indian_angle: The premier national badminton event in India, the Senior National Championships, has its venue and dates confirmed, allowing players to prepare.
summary: The Yonex-Sunrise 79th Inter State – Inter Zonal & 88th Senior National Badminton Championships 2026 will take place in Bhubaneswar, Odisha, from December 17 to 24, 2026.

title: 49th Junior National Badminton Championships to be Held in Sikkim
indian_angle: India's promising young badminton talents will compete in the 49th Junior National Championships in Sikkim, a key event for their development.
summary: The eligibility list for the Yonex-Sunrise 49th Junior National Badminton Championships 2026, scheduled from November 14 to 21 in Sikkim, has been released.

title: National Coaching Camp for BWF World Junior Championships 2026
indian_angle: Indian junior shuttlers are undergoing intensive training at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati to prepare for the upcoming BWF World Junior Championships.
summary: A national coaching camp is underway at the NCE, Guwahati, to prepare the Indian contingent for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026.
